settings.heading: Refund Policy
settings.content:
Last updated: June 2026

We want you to feel great about your purchase. If CREO isn't right for you, getting your money back should be simple — no hoops, no hassle.

Our 30-day guarantee

Every order is backed by a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you don't love your CREO Daily Creatine Gummies, just let us know within 30 days of your order and we'll issue a full refund. You keep the jar — there's no need to ship anything back to us.

How to request a refund

Email us at hello@trycreo.com with your order number (you'll find it in your confirmation email) and a quick note that you'd like a refund. That's it — we'll take care of the rest.

When you'll be refunded

Once we confirm your refund, it goes back to your original payment method. Most refunds appear within 5–10 business days, though the exact timing depends on your bank or card provider.

Subscriptions

You're in control of your subscription. Skip, pause, or cancel anytime from your account area before your next billing date — there are no fees or commitments. If a subscription order hasn't shipped yet, you can request a refund for that latest order under the same 30-day guarantee.

Damaged or wrong items

If your order arrives damaged, or you received the wrong item, we're sorry — that's on us. Email hello@trycreo.com with your order number and a photo if you can, and we'll send a free replacement right away.

Have any other questions? Our contact page and FAQ are here to help.
